notes: **Effects edit** (Create tab → Transcript to video → Style): drop a talking-head take and every sentence gets its own effect, so the video never sits still. 17 effects: paper cut-out, magazine cover, screen wall, pixel zoom, sketch boil, graph rise, glass text, orbit spin, pull-out reveal, phone frame, dolly zoom, news wall, frame pop, punch-through cut, green screen, interface world and tick list. The AI picks the one that shows what each sentence says (a list ticks off, a number becomes a rising graph, "but" punches through), never the same twice in a row. Bold captions, an effect counter in the corner, music and sound design included. Also in the MCP connector (make_effects_video)

**The AI sound designer:** before the music and sound effects are made, the AI plans them like a trailer editor: where the music lifts and breathes, which key line gets the drums dropped so it lands, and which moments get a hit. Add plain-English notes per client in brand.yaml (sound: notes). Works without AI too (rules)
**AutoCut's own voice:** a local, free voiceover engine (no account, works offline), ready for dubbing and demos
